# Content-pack cull audit - DeepWaterStation + CyberPunkAssets (2026-09-06)

**Verdict: BLOCKED.** Operator ruling R1 ("not used anywhere in our game") is false for 0.1.3-beta: both packs are HARD-imported by the shipped ARCANEON venue and were cooked, staged and shipped. A root-level NeverCook or `git rm` today reproduces the 0.1.2 "Content is missing from cook" failure on the Windows client, WindowsClient and WindowsServer (S12) cooks. **No config, content or repo change has been made.** Re-ruling needed (options in s5).

**Method:** locate on disk -> byte-level reference audit (ripgrep over every uasset/umap/ini/cpp) + a purpose-written UE5.6 package-header parser (import table = hard refs; soft-path table = soft refs) -> cooked-tree and pak audit of the 0.1.3 build -> three adversarial refutation lenses (hard refs, soft/string refs, cook mechanics) -> plan.
